jamie.devex: quick question — for the JS SDK v1.4 release, are we standardizing on global fetch or bundling undici for node runtimes?
oleg.sdk: leaning global fetch + polyfill approach so edge workers are first-class citizens. bundling undici adds weight for browser/edge users.
sam.infra: +1 for global, but we need to be explicit about minimum node versions and provide a recommended undici shim for older node LTS. also watch for retry behavior differences between fetch implementations.
andre.prod: from onboarding & support POV we should give a one-liner devs can paste. many users copy-paste from our sample apps; low friction matters.
jamie.devex: agreed. proposing default to global fetch, provide opt-in undici package for server-side perf with an example snippet and typings. draft snippet: ```js
// optional undici shim for Node <=18 or perf-critical servers
import { setGlobalDispatcher } from 'undici'
import { Agent } from 'undici'
setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent())
// then lib can rely on globalThis.fetch
```
oleg.sdk: for ESM/CJS interop we should avoid conditional require() shims that break bundlers. prefer documenting two patterns: ESM import + CJS require fallback in sample apps. also add runtime-detect helper in SDK: `detectGlobalFetch()` that returns whether fetch is usable.
sam.infra: important: auth/retry — if users swap fetch impls, behavior around streaming aborts and retry semantics can change. we should own a tiny retry wrapper inside sdk that uses AbortController and retries only idempotent calls, and expose hooks to opt out.
oleg.sdk: typing note: when we accept a custom fetch, make the type generic: `(input: RequestInfo, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>` and export a FetchLike typedef in our types so TS projects get autocomplete across ESM/CJS.
jamie.devex: can we add a short troubleshooting checklist to the quickstart? e.g., "If you see runtime: fetch is not defined -> paste shim", and example for Cloudflare Workers vs Vercel Edge vs Node.
andre.prod: yes — also include a small table in console quickstart: runtime -> recommended setup (Edge: nothing, Node 18+: global, Node <18: undici shim, Bun: global but call out headers quirk).
ci-bot: build:tests v1.4 triggered by @oleg.sdk — 3 tests failed (http-client-compat).
oleg.sdk: I'll take the failing tests. likely the retry wrapper assumptions. will iterate and ping when green.
jamie.devex: awesome. can someone add the troubleshooting blurb to the quickstart PR? i'll draft language and sample commands for package.json scripts.
sam.infra: tagging infra to ensure our CI images include node 16/18/20 to catch regressions.
oleg.sdk: plan: implement detectGlobalFetch(), add FetchLike typedef, ship optional `useUndici()` helper, and a small internal retry wrapper. will open PR with tests and samples.
jamie.devex: thanks — i'll queue the quickstart edits and update sample-apps repo with both ESM and CJS snippets.
andre.prod: good sync. if we can keep docs simple we should avoid a support spike at launch. :thumbsup:
